slides.title: Stop Applying to Cyber Jobs Cold
slides.subtitle: Warm outreach gets replies. Cold apps get silence.

bullets: Find the hiring manager on LinkedIn first
Engage with their posts for a week
Email them before you hit apply
Referrals close the gap cold apps can't

caption: Cold applications go into a black hole. The candidates getting interviews are going in warm. Here's how to flip your approach. #cybersecurity #cybersecuritycareers #jobsearch #cypherjobs #infosec
